title: AEP NL JSONL process writer lock
scope: Cross-process exclusive ledger writes with bounded wait, flush, and fsync
alternatives: Retain cooperative unlocked JSONL appends or migrate fully to SQLite now
impact: Concurrent writers wait or fail without appending; lock file becomes a runtime artifact
counter_evidence: Advisory locking is not a signed or distributed consensus mechanism
acceptance_criteria: Two spawned writers append a valid chain; timeout is bounded; lock release permits later write; journal remains compatible
rollback_reference: Revert the writer-lock implementation commit; retain existing ledger and regenerate governance artifacts.
